method: Sequential independent run.py invocations; each separate compiler, environment and native report is retained. This is not one combined invocation.

definitions.initialComparison: Native binary DOC render versus first parser DOCX render; original DOCX-to-DOC bridge changes are measured separately in each full report.
definitions.renderExact: All pixels, extracted layout text and word boxes agree on the recorded renderer; independent of strict structural comparison.
definitions.strictStructuralDifferences: Snapshot property differences include representation changes and native bridge losses; counts alone do not attribute semantic loss.
definitions.bytes: Decimal byte counts; raw report bytes and artifact bytes include some duplicate evidence by design.
